explanation: With coarse dt=0.02, light cart (0.5kg), max initial offsets (x=0.5,v=0.5,theta=0.1) and sensor noise 0.02, the fixed-gain state-feedback saturates at force_limit=40 and pumps energy each step (v grows to ~11 m/s by step 11). The controller cannot stabilize the pole at this numerical regime, so theta diverges past -0.887 rad, violating pole_upright. Likely cause: controller gains adapted to nominal plant fail under combined coarse integration, saturated actuation, and noisy feedback, leading to positive-feedback destabilization.
